lines.intro_0: Aaj main aapko ek trick sikhaungi. Iske baad shopping list bhoolna mushkil ho jayega.
lines.lesson_0: Secret yeh hai. Hamara dimaag list yaad nahi rakh paata. Lekin kahani kabhi nahi bhoolta.
lines.lesson_1: Chhe cheezein list mein? Shaam tak gayab.
lines.lesson_2: Wahi chhe cheezein ek funny kahani mein? Agle hafte bhi yaad rahengi.
lines.lesson_3: Is trick ka naam hai Story Chain.
lines.lesson_4: Pehli cheez doosri cheez ke saath kuch karti hai. Doosri, teesri ke saath. Aise hi aage.
lines.lesson_5: Jitni pagal kahani, utni pakki yaad. Boring picture nahi tikti.
lines.lesson_6: Chaliye, aaj ki list se try karte hain.
lines.story_0: Aap ek bada glass doodh pee rahe hain.
lines.story_1: Achanak, doodh se ek bread ka slice bahar nikalta hai, naav ki tarah tairta hua.
lines.story_2: Bread par ek kela baitha hai, aapko dekh kar muskura raha hai.
lines.story_3: Kela nahaa raha hai, ek gulabi sabun se.
lines.story_4: Sabun se bubbles nikal rahe hain, aur bubbles ke andar chai patti udd rahi hai.
lines.story_5: Chai patti neeche girti hai, aur chhe andon par land karti hai. Crack!
lines.story_6: Ek baar aur, jaldi se. Doodh. Bread. Kela. Sabun. Chai. Ande.
lines.story_7: Aankhein band karke ek baar aur dekhiye. Phir button dabaiye.
lines.order_1: Kahani ke order mein tap kijiye. Doodh se shuru.
lines.nudge_first: Yeh nahi. Kahani shuru hui thi, aap kuch pee rahe the.
lines.nudge_1: Abhi nahi. Sochiye. Doodh se kya nikla tha?
lines.nudge_2: Abhi nahi. Bread par kaun baitha tha?
lines.nudge_3: Abhi nahi. Kela kis se nahaa raha tha?
lines.nudge_4: Abhi nahi. Bubbles mein kya udd raha tha?
lines.nudge_5: Abhi nahi. Chai patti kahan giri thi?
lines.q0_no: Yeh nahi. Kela gulabi sabun se nahaa raha tha.
lines.q1: Kaun si cheez kahani mein nahi thi?
lines.q1_no: Yeh nahi. Chawal kahani mein kabhi tha hi nahi.
lines.q2_no: Yeh nahi. Chhe ande. Chai patti unpar giri thi. Crack!
lines.after_intro: Ab wahi test, jo shuru mein kiya tha. Lekin is baar aapke paas kahani hai. Aaj ki chhe cheezein kaun si thi? Tap kijiye.
lines.after_better: Dekha aapne? Pehle wala score aur aaj ka score, dono screen par hain. Kahani ne kaam kiya. Yahi hai Story Chain ki taakat.
lines.after_same: Score zyada nahi badla, lekin ab aapke paas ek trick hai. Kal aur behtar hoga.
lines.score_intro: Din ek poora. Yeh raha aapka brain score.
lines.score_hi: Bahut tez memory hai aapki. Chhe cheezon ki kahani banayi, aur kahani tik gayi.
lines.score_mid: Achha kaam. Kahani ne aadha kaam khud kar diya.
lines.score_lo: Achhi shuruaat. Kal kahani aur pagal banayenge, aur score upar jayega.
lines.homework: Aaj raat ek kaam. Kal ki sabzi list ke liye ek pagal si kahani banaiye. Likhna nahi. Bas kahani. Kal milte hain.
